scoring_justification: Recompute from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in verifier sandbox; the only scored artifact is the final CSV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for total magnetic moment (μB) and spin-resolved band gaps (eV) for six systems, as reported in the source paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Tables I, II and main text; values confirmed against reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper text and tables; exact values used by reference oracle.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper-reported numbers for the exact configurations required.

outputs.description: Total magnetic moments and spin-resolved band gaps for pristine 6Z-SiCNR and six defective configurations.

output_contract.notes: All V_Si+N substitution configurations are represented by V_Si^1N_C^8 as the representative case.

steps.description: Compare the computed total magnetic moments and band gaps against paper-reported values with tolerances.
